title: Metro by T-Mobile Is Offering a Free Samsung Smartphone for a Limited Time
summary: Sign up for Metro by T-Mobile and get a new Samsung Galaxy A37 5G at zero cost — no catches and no surprises.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

If you don’t want to spend loads of money to upgrade to a new smartphone, Metro by T-Mobile has a deal to save you money.

Get Metro by T-Mobile

Right now, Metro by T-Mobile just launched its free Galaxy A37 5G promotion , a no catches and no surprises promotion that works just as advertised. Plain and simple.

Switch to Metro by T-Mobile and you’ll get a free Galaxy A37 5G. Just bring your old phone number and get talk, text and 5G data with no activation fees, as well as taxes and other fees included in the price. Plus, get your monthly price locked in, thanks to Metro by T-Mobile’s 5-year price guarantee.

In April 2026, Samsung dropped its Galaxy A37 5G, a new wallet-friendly smartphone that’s made to streamline phone calls, texts, online media and photography and other features. The Galaxy A37 5G delivers Samsung’s signature performance in a sleek and compact design.

With this new Samsung Galaxy A37 5G via Metro by T-Mobile, which “Runs on T-Mobile, America’s Best Network*,” you’ll also be getting a reliable and straightforward wireless plan. The smartphone has a long battery life of up to 46 talk time per charge, a sharp 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display, a 50-megapixel wide camera system for detailed photos and video and other features. It also comes in an “awesome charcoal” colorway.

*Best mobile network in the U.S. based on analysis by Ookla® of Speedtest Intelligence® 1H 2026 data. Ookla trademarks used under license and reprinted with permission. When the network is busy, Metro speeds may be reduced vs. T-Mobile speeds due to prioritization.
